content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate overall scientific and field implementation of the PReMI study. Supervise field teams and monitor participant recruitment, intervention delivery, and follow-up. Support development and refinement of the behavioural and community-digital intervention. Coordinate with PHCs and district health authorities for smooth implementation. Monitor protocol adherence, intervention fidelity, and data quality. Contribute to statistical analysis, reporting, scientific presentations, and manuscript preparation.

faq.answer: After the evaluation of the application form, the recruitment process will be as follows: a. Written test (Epidemiology, Research Methodology, Biostatistics, Ethics) b. Interview (Epidemiology, Research Methodology, Biostatistics, Study applied for).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent position at JIPMER?
faq.answer: This position is purely on contract basis for an externally sponsored project, and the person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.
